Name: Sylvanlight Meadows By Huskyn1nja
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
Deep in the woods, bordering the Cindersap Forest, lies a forgotten glade shielded by ancient trees. The magic that once covered the land has faded, leaving its shrines dormant and its secrets sleeping. Can you restore the shrines, reawaken the glade, and build a farm in harmony with its ancient magic?

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]A New Farm Map:[/b] Sylvanlight Meadows is added through AdditionalFarms. It does NOT replace any vanilla farms and is selectable from the farm type menu when starting a new save.
[*][b]Fairycore Aesthetic[/b]: Immersive yourself in a deepwood fairy themed farm including magical glowing mushrooms and fireflies to help light the way
[*][b]An always dark farm[/b]: The farm lies deep in the woods, where sunlight can barely pierce the canopy. Leading to little differentiation between night and day
[*][b]Restore the Seven Shrines:[/b] The core of the mod. Discover seven ancient shrines on your farm, each tied to a unique color and theme. These act as custom bundles that unlock as you achieve milestones in the game.
[*][b]Unique Rewards:[/b] Each restored shrine grants a useful, custom reward, including magical items, unique recipes, machines, and permanent buffs.
[*][b]Story-Driven Progression:[/b] The glade's magic returns as you progress in the game. The Shrines Unlock conditions are tied to your skills and achievements towards the shrine's specific focus
[*][b]Multiplayer Support:[/b] Designed to work for up to 4 players.
[*][b]Accessibility Options[/b]: Config options available for players who struggle to see in the dark.
[/list]
SHRINE SPOILERS. READ AT YOUR OWN RISK
[Spoiler]
• Green Shrine (Re-growing the Wilds)
  - Requirement to Unlock: Reach Foraging Level 6.
  - Reward: Crafting Recipe -- Totem of the Wilds.
  - What is it?: A custom machine that passively generates wild forage regardless of season.
• Blue Shrine (Purifying the Waters)
  - Requirement to Unlock: Reach Fishing Level 4.
  - Reward: Expanded Fishing Selection.
  - What is it?: Ability to catch all fish on the farm regardless of season or weather requirements
• Black Shrine (Understanding the Deeps)
  - Requirement to Unlock: Reach floor 81 in the Mines.
  - Reward: The Shadow Grimoire.
  - What is it?: A book that teaches crafting recipes to create monster loot.
• Purple Shrine (Awakening the Magic)
  - Requirement to Unlock: Give a sweet Gem berry to the statue in the Secret woods.
  - Reward: The Prismatic Altar.
  - What is it?: An altar that allows you to trade 10 Diamonds for 1 Prismatic Shard on sunny days.
• Yellow Shrine (Cultivating the Meadow)
  - Requirement to Unlock: Ship at least 1 Jelly and 1 Honey.
  - Reward: Meadow's Kiss.
  - What is it?: A custom cooking recipe that gives a nice buff to Farming, Foraging, and Luck.
• Red Shrine (Healing the Soil)
  - Requirement to Unlock: Donate 15 Minerals (not artifacts) to the Museum.
  - Reward: Wildwood Infuser.
  - What is it?: A machine that converts your excess Sap, Clay, and Earth Crystals into fertilizers and retaining soil.
• Pink Shrine (Nurturing the Creatures)
  - Requirement to Unlock: Read the Animal Catalogue (Bought from Marnie) and the Raccoon Journal.
  - Reward: Blessing of Vitality.
  - What is it?: Halves the time it takes for animals on the farm to mature.
[/Spoiler]﻿

[list]
[*][b]Compatible[/b] with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) and most other major content mods.
[*][b]Compatible[/b] with most recolor mods
[*][b]NOT COMPATIBLE [/b]with any custom farm cave
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/b].
[*]Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]Crystalinerose Tilesheets[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265]Unlockable Bundles[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url]﻿
[*](Optional but Recommended) Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b].
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI and select the Sylvanlight Meadows farm when starting a new game.
[/list]
[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img]
[/b]
[list]
[*]This farm is intended to be always dark for full immersion. Options to make it lighter are available via GMCM
[*]You can [b]NOT [/b]use a custom farm cave with this map. Quest progression is tied to using the farm cave provided.
[*]Multiplayer support should work, but has not been extensively tested. Please report any issues.
[*]This mod is not tested on mobile. Inquiries about mobile support will not be answered.
[*]Certain rewards may not affect all mods. Compatibility will be addressed as they are encountered via updates.
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332750.png[/img]
